info.description: Stage 1. Same-origin cookie API; all writes require exact Origin, JSON Content-Type and X-CSRF-Protection: 1. No CORS. Login/register: 10 attempts per peer IP per 15 minutes, 4 concurrent password operations per process. Error messages are localized by clients from error.code.
